title: Easter Offensive
text: The Easter Offensive, also known as the 1972 Spring–Summer Offensive by North Vietnam, or the Fiery Red Summer in South Vietnamese literature, was a military campaign conducted by the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) against a force consisting of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) and the United States military between 30 March and 22 October 1972, during the Vietnam War.
